Zornade MCP

Model Context Protocol server for Italian cadastral data, geocoding and administrative lists. Powered by the Zornade API v2.

Endpoint

https://mcp.zornade.com/mcp

Authentication

A free Zornade API key (zrn_..., from app.zornade.com/api) must be sent as x-api-key header, Authorization: Bearer, or ?api_key= query parameter.

Tools

zornade_geocode_search   Forward geocoding (ANNCSU streets)
zornade_geocode_reverse  Reverse geocoding by coordinates
zornade_parcel_by_id     Enriched cadastral parcel profile
zornade_parcel_locate    Parcels by point(s) or bounding box
zornade_parcel_search    Parcels by comune, foglio, label
zornade_admin_lists      Regions, provinces, municipalities

Connect (Claude Code)

claude mcp add zornade -t http https://mcp.zornade.com/mcp \
  --header "x-api-key: zrn_YOUR_KEY"

Test

curl -X POST https://mcp.zornade.com/mcp \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "Accept: application/json, text/event-stream" \
  -H "x-api-key: zrn_YOUR_KEY" \
  -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"tools/list"}'
